text:
Riley: Does anyone else hear the conference room chair whisper at 2pm or is it just me? It squeaks like it has opinions. :chair:
Sam: It's not whispering, it's leading a council. It voted to ban swivel meetings last week. :laughing:
Dee: I nominate we officially name it. Suggestions: Sir Squeaksalot, Madame Creak, The Silent Strategist. Vote with emoji.
Harper: Sir Squeaksalot wins my heart. Also propose a tiny coronation: new keeper sits in the chair and tells a one-line embarrassing story. Low-effort bonding.
Jules: Rules draft: 1) Chair coronation once a quarter 2) Keeper gets temporary Slack nickname "Squeakkeeper" for one week 3) No permanent stickers on the chair 4) If you break the chair you sponsor donuts.
Riley: Add photo evidence rule: take a selfie with the Keeper sash. Must be posted in #random within 24h or the title reverts. :camera_with_flash:
Sam: Who makes the sash? I can craft a tiny one from orange sticky notes. Durable and dramatic. :scissors:
Dee: Can ChairBot announce coronations? ChairBot, can you add a recurring reminder for coronation nominations?
ChairBot: Reminder created: "Chair Coronation Nominations" every 90 days at 14:00. (Created by ChairBot)
Harper: Also idea: onboarding tradition where the new hire sits in Sir Squeaksalot and gets a 10-second mentorship whisper (funny and optional). Keeps lore alive.
Jules: Temporary punishment: if you refuse to sit in the chair during coronation, you must narrate a 30-second dramatic reading of the last commit message. :books:
Riley: Coronation candidates? I'm putting Sam and Harper forward. Sam is up if they accept.
Sam: I accept under two conditions: 1) I get to pick the coronation soundtrack (voted by reactions) and 2) I can choose the sash color.
Dee: Accepted. I'm on sash duty and will make a shortlist of songs. Also suggesting a tiny plaque: "Sir Squeaksalot: Keeper of Quiet Meetings". Low-effort laser print.
ChairBot: Logged: "Coronation candidates: Sam, Harper". Reminder set: "Prepare sash and plaque" in 3 days. (ChairBot)
Harper: Friday standup after lunch for coronation? Remote folks can upload a 5-10s video of themselves waving at the chair.
Riley: Friday works. Whoever wins has to write one sentence of seat wisdom in the handbook under Culture. Example: "Respect the squeak, cherish the swivel."
Sam: I'm honored and also mildly terrified. May Sir Squeaksalot bless our ergonomics. :crossed_fingers:
Jules: Long live Sir Squeaksalot. Meeting adjourned. No illegal chair-dunking in the Keurig.
